enriched.summary: A aula aborda o uso do Simple Past e do Past Continuous, além do verbo 'to be' no passado, com exemplos práticos de frases afirmativas, negativas e interrogativas. Também inclui vocabulário relacionado a refeições e atividades cotidianas, além de expressões úteis para o dia a dia.
mainTopics: Vocabulary about meals and daily activities

examples: Was John drunk? (O John estava bêbado?)
No, he wasn’t. (Não, ele não estava.)
Did he drink water during the meal? (Ele bebeu água durante a refeição?)
No, he didn’t. (Não, ele não bebeu.)

vocabulary.definition: Past tense of 'eat', meaning to consume food.
examples: Daniel ate pasta yesterday. (Daniel comeu massa ontem.)
What did he eat for dessert? (O que ele comeu na sobremesa?)

vocabulary.definition: A type of Italian food made from flour and water, often served with sauce.
examples: Daniel ate pasta yesterday. (Daniel comeu massa ontem.)

vocabulary.definition: Sweet food served at the end of a meal.
examples: What did he eat for dessert? (O que ele comeu na sobremesa?)

grammar.explanation: The verb 'to be' changes its form in the past tense depending on the subject. 'Was' is used for singular subjects (I, he, she, it), and 'were' is used for plural subjects (we, you, they).
examples: John was at the party yesterday. (John estava na festa ontem.)
John wasn’t at home. (John não estava em casa.)
Was John drunk? (O John estava bêbado?)
No, he wasn’t. (Não, ele não estava.)
commonMistakes: Using 'was' for plural subjects: 'They was happy' instead of 'They were happy.'

grammar.explanation: The Past Continuous is used to describe actions that were ongoing in the past. It is formed with 'was/were + verb + -ing'.
rules: Add '-ing' to the base form of the verb.
examples: I took the photo while they were writing a song. (Eu tirei a foto enquanto eles estavam escrevendo uma música.)
While I was doing my English class, my wife was doing the dishes. (Enquanto eu estava fazendo minha aula de inglês, minha esposa estava lavando a louça.)
commonMistakes: Forgetting to use 'was/were': 'They writing' instead of 'They were writing.'
Incorrect spelling of '-ing' form: 'writeing' instead of 'writing.'

expressions.usage: Used to refer to cleaning plates, cups, and other utensils after a meal.
examples: While I was doing my English class, my wife was doing the dishes. (Enquanto eu estava fazendo minha aula de inglês, minha esposa estava lavando a louça.)

practiceQuestions.question: Translate: 'Daniel comeu massa ontem.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The sentence uses the Simple Past tense of the verb 'eat', which becomes 'ate' in the past.

practiceQuestions.question: Form a question: 'John estava na festa ontem.'
practiceQuestions.answer: Was John at the party yesterday?
practiceQuestions.explanation: To form a question with the verb 'to be' in the past, invert the subject and the verb.

practiceQuestions.question: Choose the correct verb form: 'While they ___ a song, I took a photo.'
practiceQuestions.explanation: The Past Continuous ('were writing') is used to describe an ongoing action in the past.

culturalNotes: In English-speaking countries, meals often include dessert, which can range from cakes to fruits.
The expression 'do the dishes' is commonly used in daily conversations about household chores.
studyTips: Practice using the Simple Past by describing your daily activities from yesterday.
Use flashcards to memorize irregular verbs and their past forms.
Create sentences using the Past Continuous to describe simultaneous actions.
originalExamples: Daniel ate pasta yesterday. (Daniel comeu massa ontem.)
He didn’t eat rice, beans and meat. (Ele não comeu arroz, feijão e carne.)
Did he eat two portions / servings? (Ele comeu duas porções?)
Yes, he did. (Sim, ele comeu.)
Did he drink water during the meal? (Ele bebeu água durante a refeição?)
No, he didn’t. (Não, ele não bebeu.)
What did he eat for dessert? (O que ele comeu na sobremesa?)
Nothing. (Nada.)
John was at the party yesterday. (John estava na festa ontem.)
John wasn’t at home. (John não estava em casa.)
Was John with Mary? (O John estava com a Mary?)
Yes, he was. (Sim, ele estava.)
Was John drunk? (O John estava bêbado?)
No, he wasn’t. (Não, ele não estava.)
Why was he nervous? (Por que ele estava nervoso?)
He wasn’t nervous. (Ele não estava nervoso.)
My friends were at the gym yesterday. (Meus amigos estavam na academia ontem.)
My friends weren’t in the park yesterday. (Meus amigos não estavam no parque ontem.)
Were your friends at home? (Seus amigos estavam em casa?)
No, they weren’t. (Não, eles não estavam.)
Were your friends together? (Seus amigos estavam juntos?)
Yes, they were. (Sim, eles estavam.)
How long were your friends at the gym? (Quanto tempo seus amigos estavam na academia?)
For about 1.5 hours. (Por cerca de 1.5 horas.)
When I took the photo, they were writing a song. (Quando eu tirei a foto, eles estavam escrevendo uma música.)
They were writing a song when I took the photo. (Eles estavam escrevendo uma música quando eu tirei a foto.)
I took the photo while they were writing a song. (Eu tirei a foto enquanto eles estavam escrevendo uma música.)
While they were writing a song, I took a photo. (Enquanto eles estavam escrevendo uma música, eu tirei uma foto.)
While I was doing my English class, my wife was doing the dishes. (Enquanto eu estava fazendo minha aula de inglês, minha esposa estava lavando a louça.)
